verdict.rationale: The docs state that Omarchy includes the Aether application for creating a new theme 'using a lovely GUI interface to play with colors and search for backgrounds.' This matches the story's GUI color and background picker directly. Other docs confirm that a theme restyles the whole system (terminal, bar, notifications, wallpaper) and that users can make their own themes. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of Aether's color-picking and background-search workflow, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the GUI-created themes apply system-wide.
